primaryChecks.text: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

context.text: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

primaryChecks.text: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

context.text: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

context.text: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.
They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

context.text: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.
